summary: Iteration 2: revalidated backend regression suite (31/31 pytest passed) and frontend flows after AI summarize LLM recharge + Invoices/Telehealth refactors. AI summarization now works end-to-end (real summary populates nf-summary and AI Summary block appears in the saved note card). Invoices flow works: created invoice with 2 different CPT items, total $185.00 correct, saved, marked Paid. Telehealth ad-hoc session mounts the Jitsi iframe successfully (start-adhoc-btn works after useMemo change). Regression of login/patients/appointments/notes/forms/messages/stats/RBAC 403 all green.

ui_bugs.issue: Biller role sees the 'Add Patient' button in the UI even though backend correctly returns 403. Button should be hidden for roles that cannot create patients (biller). Similar RBAC-in-UI check likely missing on other add buttons.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — appears to be injected instrumentation from ve-dynamic tooling, not application code; benign in preview.

action_items: Optional UI polish: hide add-patient-btn (and other role-restricted create buttons) for roles without permission — e.g., biller. Backend RBAC already enforced (403), so this is UX-only.
critical_code_review_comments: RBAC is enforced only at API level; several create/edit buttons render for all roles and only fail on submit. Consider a small `can(role, action)` helper in frontend to hide/disable actions the user can't perform.
Notes.js: AI summarize does not disable the submit button or show a spinner in the summary textarea while streaming — minor UX nit; currently shows a disabled button state which is fine.
Invoices.js _uid keys fix looks correct — add/remove line items no longer re-mount other rows. Verified by adding 2 items and computing total $185.00 correctly.
Telehealth.js activeAppts useMemo change works — page renders without errors and start-adhoc-btn correctly mounts Jitsi container.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed patient/appointment/note/invoice/form/message via pytest; delete tests cleaned patient+appointment. A TEST_AI_Visit note and 2 invoices remain in DB from Playwright flow (harmless demo data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI summarize (POST /api/notes/summarize) confirmed working with gpt-5.4 via emergentintegrations — returns real multi-line clinical summary (~350 chars) in ~5-15s. Invoices and Telehealth refactors verified. Only remaining polish item is hiding role-restricted create buttons in the UI (backend RBAC already correct).
rca of the issue: N/A — no new bugs. The biller-sees-add-patient-btn observation is a pre-existing UX limitation, not caused by this iteration's changes.
